en.headline: Hong Kong exports surge 50.7 per cent in July on AI electronics demand
en.dek: The value of merchandise exports rose to a record HK$672.5 billion, while imports grew 41 per cent, according to provisional figures from the Census and Statistics Department.
body: Hong Kong’s merchandise exports rose 50.7 per cent year on year in July to a record HK$672.5 billion, driven by strong demand for artificial-intelligence-related electronic products, the Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday.

Imports increased 41.0 per cent to HK$677.4 billion, leaving a visible trade deficit of HK$4.9 billion, or 0.7 per cent of the value of imports. For the first seven months of 2026, exports were up 40.9 per cent and imports 40.6 per cent compared with the same period in 2025.

A government spokesman said exports of AI-related electronic products again registered particularly impressive growth and that robust global demand for these goods was expected to continue supporting the city’s trade performance. He cautioned, however, that geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and rising trade protectionism remained downside risks.

zh.headline: 7月出口按年升50.7% AI相關電子產品需求強勁
zh.dek: 政府統計處公布，7月商品整體出口貨值達6725億元創新高，進口升41%，有形貿易逆差49億元。
body: 政府統計處星期二公布，2026年7月本港商品整體出口貨值按年上升50.7%至6725億元，創單月新高，主要受人工智能相關電子產品強勁需求帶動。
同期進口貨值上升41.0%至6774億元，有形貿易逆差49億元，相當於進口貨值的0.7%。2026年首七個月出口及進口貨值分別較上年同期上升40.9%及40.6%。
政府發言人表示，AI相關電子產品出口再次錄得特別強勁增長，預期全球對該類產品的需求將繼續支持本港貿易表現，但中東地緣政治緊張及部分先進經濟體貿易保護主義升溫仍構成下行風險。
